dataflows.name: Australian National Accounts Key Aggregates
dataflows.description: Dataset: ANA_AGG. Headline statistics from the quarterly national accounts. Includes gross domestic product (GDP), GDP per capita, real income measures, and the household saving ratio

descriptions.en: Dataset: ANA_AGG. Headline statistics from the quarterly national accounts. Includes gross domestic product (GDP), GDP per capita, real income measures, and the household saving ratio

dataflows.name: Australian National Accounts - State Final Demand

names.en: Australian National Accounts - State Final Demand

dataflows.description: Dataset: ANA_SFD. Quarterly estimates of state final demand (SFD) and component series, measured in chain volume measures. Includes household and government expenditure, private and public sector investment, and compensation of employees by state. Catalogue number 5206.0.

descriptions.en: Dataset: ANA_SFD. Quarterly estimates of state final demand (SFD) and component series, measured in chain volume measures. Includes household and government expenditure, private and public sector investment, and compensation of employees by state. Catalogue number 5206.0.

dataflows.name: Consumer Price Index (CPI)
dataflows.description: Dataset: CPI. The Consumer Price Index (CPI) measures changes in the price of a 'basket' of goods and services which account for a high proportion of expenditure by the CPI population group (i.e. metropolitan households). Unit of measure: Index. Geographic coverage: Australia/State. Catalogue number: 6401.0

descriptions.en: Dataset: CPI. Unit of measure: Index. Geographic coverage: Australia/State. Catalogue number: 6401.0
